name: ai-launchpad
description: Back-office help for an Estonian small business, inside the assistant you already use. It looks up public company facts, lists deadlines, and walks you through linking accounting, e-mail or your bank. You sign in yourself. Your assistant does the jobs you ask for and records each one. You make payments and official filings yourself.

Your assistant does the jobs you ask for and records each one. You make payments and official filings yourself.
capabilities: Plain-words help linking accounting, e-mail and bank
Records every action it takes for you
